You are working in an environment with Node.js installed. A file `/home/user/recipients.json` already exists containing a list of email addresses.

Write a Node.js script at `/home/user/airdrop.js` that reads `/home/user/recipients.json` and uses the Crossmint Minting REST API to attempt to mint a "Welcome NFT" to each recipient on `polygon-amoy`.

The script must:

1. Read the recipients list from `/home/user/recipients.json` (an array of email strings)
2. For each email, construct a recipient string in the format `email:<email>:polygon-amoy` and call the Crossmint Minting API at `https://staging.crossmint.com/api/2022-06-09/collections/default/nfts`
3. Use the `CROSSMINT_API_KEY` environment variable for the `x-api-key` header
4. NFT metadata: `name` = `"Welcome NFT"`, `description` = `"Airdrop token"`, `image` = `"https://example.com/welcome.png"`
5. After processing all recipients, write a summary to `/home/user/airdrop_summary.json` — a JSON object with:
   * `total`: total number of recipients processed
   * `results`: an array of objects, each with `email` (the address) and `status` (`"sent"` on HTTP 200/202, `"error"` otherwise) and optionally `response` (the raw API response body)

Handle per-recipient errors gracefully — if one mint fails, continue processing the rest.
